instruction: Review twin_fixture.step. For the steps below, open the part in FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad`, then carry out the Path workbench edits when working on `twin_fixture.step`. Create two FreeCAD Path Jobs or two equivalent machining coordinate groups for the two parts. Both parts must receive Face and Profile operations. The first machining region corresponds to G54 or the default work coordinate, and the second to G55 or an equivalent relative offset. Tool definition: T1 is an 8 mm end mill reused for both machining coordinate groups. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-13.nc.
